name: RCSI - Bahrain
summary: Private, not-for-profit health-sciences university in Busaiteen, Bahrain, offering medicine and nursing degrees linked to the NUI.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: A five- or six-year school-leaver medical degree with biomedical sciences, clinical-skills training and supervised hospital placements in Bahrain.
programmes.overview: Students begin with integrated anatomy, physiology, molecular science, mechanisms of disease and early clinical and communication skills; an additional foundation year supports entrants placed on the six-year route. Case-based learning in small groups, simulation, practical sessions and student-choice modules connect science to patient care. Later years include hospital attachments in medicine, surgery and other specialties across Bahrain, with an individual research or audit project and a final-year sub-internship. The degree prepares graduates for subsequent clinical training, subject to local licensing rules.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic selection and structured interview; Casper now listed. Committee assigns five- or six-year entry. Confirm 2027 requirements.
programmes.ib: Current page: 36/45 for five-year entry or 31/45 for six years, including core. It still carries a 2026 banner; confirm the 2027 points and subject rules.

programmes.name: Undergraduate Nursing
programmes.about: A four-year honours nursing degree combining nursing science, simulated practice and supervised clinical placements in Bahrain.
programmes.overview: The four-year course develops nursing assessment, communication, anatomy and physiology alongside early clinical placement. Students progress through adult and older-person care, mental health, public health, maternal and child health, critical care, leadership and evidence-based practice. Teaching combines lectures, small-group cases, clinical-skills laboratories, simulation and assessed placements in Bahrain. The final year consolidates clinical practice and includes a student-selected component, preparing graduates for nursing practice subject to professional registration rules.
programmes.selectionNote: Competitive review and recorded interview, followed by Aptis English for accepted applicants. Current page marks September 2027 admissions closed.
